b: Old man (68) here. My 25 year marriage ended almost 20 years ago. We had a good life, both working professionals. Had 2 sons, 34 and 40 now. I have no other family. Abandoned as a baby, passed around from one uncaring unloving family member or orphanages or boarding schools or useless caregivers to another. Attended more than a dozen schools in many countries before ending up here as a teen.
Finished school, got a degree, a career, met a nice teacher, hit it off, had a good run.

That is, until everyone neared the age of 45 - 50. I was more than happy, but my ex made friends with some manipulative DIVORCED women who gave her sage advice, that a much better life with a much better man, fun, parties, awaited her. So she drank the kool-aid, cheated while of a girls vacation to Cancun, and that was that.

For the record, she met one loser after another who abused her, took her money, squatted in her house, and today, well, she is living the same life as her alcoholic still single cronies. You know the ones, women in their 60's, too much makeup, too many rings, nails too long and fake, trying to recapture or maintain the glory days.

After the divorce, I moved on with my life. No idea what to expect. Go on dating sites, everyone advised, so I did. High standards, after a few years, i met a professional woman, director of marketing for a mega corporation. We hit it off, but after a couple of years, it became apparent that she liked working 6 days a week, 12 - 14 hours a day, more than having a relationship. Then she met an old co-worker while on a business trip, slept with him, and that was that. She ended up marring him, but that lasted 3 years. Today, she is still single.

A year went by. More cautious, dated a bit and met a nice, nerdy bookworm. Introverted, we shared many common interests. We lived about 90 minutes drive apart. Taking turns being at each others place on the weekends. Three years went by, and we had a good relationship, thinking marriage. Then her single for a dozen years BFF talked her into going out with the girls on Saturday nights. So she started to blow me off to party on the weekends. I would see her twice a month, if lucky. Then the revelation that she had been cheating. And that was that. Today, 10 years later, she and her cronies, still hitting the bars, still single.

Another year went by. dated a bit but nothing serious. Then I met a lady who, like me, had bounced through many schools and countries. We hit it off and started the usual weekends at each others place thing. Two years went by. Then, some dude she had the hots for from before meeting me, crawled out of the woodwork and let her know his divorce was final and was she available. Oh, she was more than willing. She slept with him a bunch of times on her way over to my place, then left me for him. Funny thing, he messaged me a few years ago, asking me if while I was with her, did I ever suspect her of cheating? yeah, with YOU! I replied. She cheated on him too. We had a good laugh, met for a beer and toasted our bullet dodging. Today, 7 years later, she is still single.

Then 2020, COVID hit and we all locked down for a year or more. No dating. Spring 2021, met a nice, quiet lady, a year older than myself. She came from a large family, was married twice, both to rural men who turned out to be alcoholic and abusive. Being together felt different, more different than with anyone else. Calming, Serenity, At peace. After 18 months, we both retired and got married. She didn't have much to her name, other than large car debt and some ratty furniture. I had assets from my career as an engineer. With my cash, we bought a house, under both our names. We made 14 trips overseas through 25 countries, all on my dime. No worries or concerns or issues.

I said, everything comes at a price. She is warm and cuddly, but sex, not a big thing for her. Almost zero interest. Once a month, or every two months, good enough for her. I got used to it. The stability of this marriage is, unlike the others, because her sex drive is low, she doesn't seek it elsewhere. And I am OK with it. It's worth it.
